{"text":"MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The magnetic V-pads partly matched my interest in using magnets to hold things securely, as reflected in my recent magnetic hook purchases.",
    "Recommending practical hardware recognized part of my recent shopping intent, although none of these items met a current need strongly enough for me to choose it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wire connectors, cable insulation, battery terminals and test leads require electrical projects that my recent fastening and hanging purchases do not imply.",
    "The magnetic stirrer shares a magnetic mechanism with my hooks, but mixing liquids serves a completely different purpose from hanging or securing objects.",
    "Examination gloves and COVID tests do not address the needs reflected in my recent purchases, and I have no stated reason to buy them.",
    "Even the magnetic V-pads are too specialized for my current needs; an interest in magnetic hooks does not mean I need workholding equipment."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hardware seemed to be treated as interest in electrical repair and electronic components generally.",
    "The presence of magnets seemed to matter more than what I would actually use the magnetic item to do.",
    "Buying assortments of fasteners seemed to be taken as a reason to recommend assortments of unrelated components."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases cluster around mechanical fastening and magnetic hanging, so the intended task matters more to me than a shared material or broad hardware connection.",
    "My two recent magnetic hook purchases give a more specific clue about my immediate interests than my older hand truck purchase.",
    "I rarely interact unless something is clearly useful now; a possible use in an unmentioned future project is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in practical hardware but stretched fastening and magnetic hanging into unrelated electrical, laboratory and medical needs."
}"}
